jobs.jobExcerpt: Kestrel Health is looking for a Generative AI Engineer.
jobs.jobDescription:
Kestrel Health is a remote-first team building software used by customers in more than 40 countries.

You will design, build and ship production features powered by large language models (LLMs) and Generative AI. Day to day you will work with the OpenAI and Anthropic Claude APIs, build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with LangChain and a vector database (pgvector / Pinecone), and evaluate prompts systematically.

  • Build AI agents that call internal tools
  • Own prompt engineering and evaluation
  • Write clean Python and TypeScript

Candidates must be located in the United States and authorized to work in the US.

Benefits: flexible hours, home-office budget, learning stipend and paid time off.
